exact_statement: For any integer-valued Z, integer j, a=E(Z-j), b=E((Z-j)^2), V=b-a^2 and 0<b<=1/4: |a|<=b and V>=b(1-b)>0. If j=0 then 0<=h(EZ)/V<=2b ln(1/b)/(1-b). If j=sigma in {-1,1} then |h(EZ)/V+2sigma*a/b|<=8b, where h(x)=x^2 ln(1/x^2), h(0)=0. For actual Boolean mixed cofactors this quotient equals signed corrected entropy residual divided by complete strict-superset Fourier mass, even when v_S tends to zero through positive values. AND codimension-one profiles have exact ratio phi(p)=2p ln(1/p)/(1-p), with independent-rate zero/unit endpoint errors as in PROOF.md; their sum is <=3 times top-packet degree deficit for d>=3. No universal summed entropy bound follows.
